name: mordomo-os
description: MordomoOS — a local, vendor-neutral agentic operating system (ARMS) over Claude Code, Cursor Agent and OpenAI Codex.

scripts.build: tsc -b core adapters/claude adapters/cursor adapters/codex apps/api && npm run build -w apps/command-centre
scripts.build:server: tsc -b core adapters/claude adapters/cursor adapters/codex apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b core adapters/claude adapters/cursor adapters/codex apps/api --noEmit false && npm run typecheck -w apps/command-centre
